sources.title: Alalcomenaeus cambricus — Royal Ontario Museum Burgess Shale collection
sources.museum_caption: ROM45616 is a complete55mm specimen, part/counterpart, lateral. ROM53352 is complete45mm, lateral, dry/wet light versions. Both photographed by Jean-Bernard Caron.
sources.pixel_notes: Local full-resolution photographs viewed. Whole head/trunk/tail outlines and limb arrays visible; dark patches and matrix fractures not interpreted as live color/anatomy. Fine ocellar number is NOT independently established from these lateral photographs.
